bounds.domain: One runtime, two sequential worker generations, one deferred boot hook per generation, one admitted row reconciliation and one canonical driver row. The initial row may already exist.
bounds.scope: Plugin unload revokes boot admission before joining the in-flight reconciliation and reading storage for deletion. The write can fail before effect or commit with a lost acknowledgement. A cleanup error is observable and may retain a row for a later reload to reconcile. Full runtime stop, seed task internals, consumer tick takeover, running task effects, duplicate legacy rows, independent runtimes and general storage guarantees are outside this projection.

assumptions: Weak fairness of advance means the admitted row operation settles and final cleanup reads and deletes settle. Either can fail. Reload begins after the old unload completes.
Storage reports the result of each read or write. No wall-clock unload deadline or guarantee of successful deletion is proved.
No fairness is assumed. A pending reconciliation or cleanup operation may never settle.
